title: Known-object test, TOI-3756.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-3756.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, partial, recovered (18 covered epochs). Residual screen: 279 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 3 light curve(s), forming 139 distinct event(s), 8 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460286.0496 (ΔT 373.59 d); 0 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
